edits.text: - Does translating the piece before the marker on its own fail to supply material needed to reconstruct the whole sentence? Most severe when a verb and its core object or an essential coreference are split, or when the cut falls immediately after a single-word function token (determiner, pronoun, auxiliary, or discourse connective) that must be read with its following phrase; milder when only optional descriptors or peripheral adjuncts are postponed.
edits._was: - Does translating the piece before the marker on its own fail to supply material needed to reconstruct the whole sentence? Worst when a verb and its core object or essential coreference are split; milder when only optional descriptors or peripheral adjuncts are postponed.

edits.text: When one candidate is immediately after a single-word function token and the other is later inside the following phrase, prefer the later cut (keep the function word attached to its content).
edits._was: - When one marker lies between a verb and its core object and another earlier marker falls inside a preceding adjunct, prefer the marker that keeps the verb and its object together.
